name: Psí školka a hotel - nejen pro pejsky
short_description: Dog hotel and daycare in Dolni Pocernice offering continuous boarding, daily care, and individual attention.
short_description_local: Psí hotel a denní školka v Dolních Počernicích nabízející celoroční ubytování, denní péči a individuální přístup.
description: Psí školka a hotel - nejen pro pejsky provides overnight dog boarding and daytime daycare. Dogs are accommodated in indoor spaces with garden access, and the facility operates continuously throughout the year with required vaccination records.
